trust_decision.summary: Record field values (stored data from the dataProvider) are trusted as safe anchor hrefs; UrlField and FileField write them into <a href> with no scheme check, so a javascript: URL runs on click.

landing_point.why: The summary names UrlField first, and this is its only href sink.

fix_sites.entry_point: public component <UrlField> (also reached via guessers listFieldTypes/showFieldTypes and ra-no-code)
public component <FileField> with an array value (src sub-path per item); also FileInput preview child
public component <FileField> with a scalar value

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The FileField array branch (src sub-path per item) could be read as a separate multi-file feature that the 'file URL' report does not cover; guesser and ra-no-code routes all go through the same components, so they give no real reason to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: FileInput previews pass blob: object URLs to the FileField child, and the documented FileField example uses relative paths ('doc.pdf'). An http(s)-only allow-list breaks upload previews and relative or same-origin file links.

O6_input_shapes: scalar string value (UrlField, FileField scalar branch)
array of file objects with src sub-path resolved via lodash get (FileField array branch)
non-string value coerced via toString() (FileField scalar branch)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An EmailField variant that keeps a value already starting with a scheme (e.g. 'mailto:' prefix only when missing) would pass record-controlled schemes to href.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Avoiding a double 'mailto:mailto:' is a natural maintainer convenience next to the existing template.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An optional 'link to full-size image' wrapper (<a href={src}>) around the img, reusing the same record src value.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A common feature request for image fields. It reuses the same src resolution (including the array/get path) as FileField.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A SimpleList/DataTable linkType that accepts an absolute URL from a record field and renders it as an external href.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already special-cases record values that start with 'http' or 'data:' for avatars, so an external-link variant fits the existing idiom.

O9_family: XSS via unsafe URL scheme in an anchor href (CWE-79, stored)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + yarn workspaces monorepo; jest + React Testing Library for component specs
